title: GovZero ADR audit-check thresholds
description: Threshold knobs for `gz adr audit-check` heuristics. Authored under OBPI-0.0.23-05 to operationalize the Skipped cheap verification failure shape codified in .gzkit/rules/agent-failure-modes.md. The same-commit-window @covers backfill heuristic flags decorators introduced within max_covers_backfill_commits commits OR max_covers_backfill_days days of the closing receipt for the corresponding REQ.

max_covers_backfill_commits.description: Maximum commit gap (introducing commit -> closing receipt) below which a @covers decorator is flagged as a same-commit-window backfill candidate.

max_covers_backfill_days.description: Maximum date gap in days (introducing commit date -> closing receipt date) below which a @covers decorator is flagged as a same-commit-window backfill candidate.
